canonical_example.translation: I don't see anything funny about this.

canonical_example.text: No veo por qué tengo que trabajar.
canonical_example.translation: I don't understand why I have to work.

canonical_example.text: No la veo viviendo en otro país.
canonical_example.translation: I can't see her living in another country.

canonical_example.text: Todavía los puedo ver como si fuera ayer.
canonical_example.translation: I can still imagine you guys like it was yesterday.

canonical_example.text: Tienes que ver al cliente mañana.
canonical_example.translation: You have to meet with the client tomorrow.

canonical_example.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

canonical_example.translation: Well, in my view, education should be free for everyone.

canonical_example.text: Los bancos del parque están recién pintados.

canonical_example.translation: The church looks empty without the pews.

canonical_example.translation: The blood bank needs donors of all blood types.

canonical_example.translation: Many visitors are attracted to the area because schools of tropical fish can be seen in the crystal-clear waters.

canonical_example.translation: We saw a shoal of tuna while we were diving.

canonical_example.text: Aquí la vegetación acuática incluye bancos de algas.
canonical_example.translation: The aquatic vegetation here includes banks of seaweed.

canonical_example.text: ¿Te olvidaste la billetera? No pasa nada; yo te banco.
canonical_example.translation: You forgot your wallet? Don't worry; I'll pay for you.

canonical_example.text: ¡Qué mina insoportable! No la banco más.
canonical_example.translation: She's so annoying! I can't stand her anymore.

canonical_example.text: Lo siento pero hoy no tengo tiempo para bancar tu malhumor.
canonical_example.translation: I'm sorry but I don't have time to put up with your bad mood today.

canonical_example.text: Corté con mi novio porque no podía bancar sus mentiras.
canonical_example.translation: I dumped my boyfriend because I couldn't bear his lies.

canonical_example.text: Mariana es inteligente y va a ser una gran líder. Yo la banco.
canonical_example.translation: Mariana is smart and will be a great leader. I support her.

canonical_example.text: No me banco este calor. Voy a darme una ducha fría.
canonical_example.translation: I can't stand this hot weather. I'm going to take a cold shower.

canonical_example.text: ¿Vas a pelear conmigo o no te la bancás?
canonical_example.translation: Are you going to fight me or do you not have the guts?

canonical_example.translation: Try to push start the car in second.

canonical_example.translation: The second time I traveled to Spain, I ended up staying for three years.

canonical_example.translation: There are sixty seconds in a minute.

canonical_example.translation: Listen, the first one is mine and the second one is yours.

canonical_example.translation: Andrew shifted into second gear and turned right.

canonical_example.translation: Seeing that no one replied to his greeting, Pablo repeated it.

canonical_example.translation: Mario won the competition, and Alberto came second.

canonical_example.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

canonical_example.translation: Hello, can you hear me?

canonical_example.text: ¿Me escucharás si te digo que no desesperes?
canonical_example.translation: Will you listen to me if I tell you not to panic?

canonical_example.translation: Sometimes I listen to myself and I don't know what I'm saying.

canonical_example.translation: She loves hearing herself telling her stories and making her friends laugh.

canonical_example.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
canonical_example.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

canonical_example.text: A mi regreso, me di cuenta de que la ventana del salón estaba abierta.

canonical_example.translation: He set off on his return journey very early in the morning to make the most of the day.

canonical_example.translation: Return with the receipt if you want store credit.

canonical_example.text: Solo llevo una semana de vuelta, pero ya quiero regresar a España.
canonical_example.translation: I've only been back a week and I already want to go back to Spain.

canonical_example.translation: You'll have to return the dress if it doesn't fit.

canonical_example.text: Regrésale los libros cuando termines con ellos.
canonical_example.translation: Give the books back to him when you've finished with them.

canonical_example.translation: He came back to the place of his birth.
